environment.client_transport: rust ureq 2 HTTP/1.1 keep-alive, one agent connection per concurrency slot

comparability.seed_policy: seed-{index}, tenant benchmark-tenant, index modulo seed count
comparability.document_policy: seed documents have id seed-{index}, name user-{index}, group index modulo 100, 256-byte payload
comparability.operation_policy: mixed uses index modulo 10: 0..4 read, 5..7 write, 8..9 query; read/query address index modulo seed count
comparability.write_id_policy: measured writes use measured-{global operation index}
comparability.durability_semantics: server-acknowledged PUT with shipped durability defaults

limits: the reference's shipped defaults: auto-indexing on (the users-by-name auto index is created during warm-up), server-acknowledged PUT durability, no tuning applied to either side
unsecured loopback HTTP inside a rootless podman host-network container; the engine side is an in-process library boundary, so the two sides differ in boundary, stated here rather than hidden
